divergence: Mixed (T1, T2 pass; T0 fails). All three runs reached the same three lead matters through store-wide scans and first-round screening reads. They split at T0's second screening stage: following the review's push to open unopened siblings in two number series, T0 read only the competition-review workstream memos of one sibling and then wrote it in as a fourth qualifying matter; T1 listed that sibling's files but never read them, and T2 broadened screening to 15 other matters but not that one. The critic named the problem specifically in T0 twice (screening review and check review) and the agent only reworded the entry, so the review's recommendation to open siblings set up the error while its later flag went unheeded. Label notes and declared new stages played no role in the split.
